original_C_metrics.temperature_selection: equal-family, equal-three-types NLL; ties closest to1 then smallerT
original_C_metrics.policy_selection: maximum coverage with positive accepts and empirical accepted error<=0.05, ties higher threshold; no feasible policy means all handoff
original_C_metrics.accepted_rule: calibrated p_max>=tau AND chosen ID != none AND same-entity choice_info prediction=yes
original_C_metrics.accepted_error: choice wrong OR world unsupported OR gold required information insufficient
original_C_metrics.scope: single project-authored rule-world generator; held-out state wording template is not independent corpus/pretraining-unseen evidence
